name: SVO Walk (Traversal) — fast_walk
definition: A traversal algorithm for a Bounding Volume Hierarchy (BVH) where leaf nodes point to SVO structures. It uses ray-sphere intersection to cull BVH nodes and delegates leaf traversal to the SVO ray marcher.
summary: fast_walk is a hybrid ray traversal algorithm that combines BVH coarse culling with SVO fine-grained density evaluation to efficiently render large sparse volumetric datasets.
